ModMetaData.name: Aftermath Test
ModMetaData.author: Nahuel
ModMetaData.description: Test harness for Aftermath (nahuel.aftermath). Only does something under `rw launch --ticks N` (command-line arg -rwtools-ticks): from tick 4600 it drives the five features through real raids, kills, downings, burials, beds and sick visits, and logs [Test] PASS/FAIL lines. With showcase.flag present and no --ticks, it stages the five features after tick 6000 and captures screenshots into logs/showcase/aftermath. Not for normal play.
